body:
Ah, sorry for that.

https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/60644 (I think the issue may be incorrect because window should be undefined in web worker)

Also duplicates https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/61740
The same behavior: 14.0.5-canary.19 is OK, 14.0.5-canary.20 is broken.

I think both https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/60644 and https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/61740 does not address the issue correctly. `window` should be `undefined`, but `typeof window !== 'undefined'` should be false in a web worker context. (Or, does webpack create a window variable for workers?)

I highly suspect #59569 is the root cause. `isAppBrowserLayer` does not imply this is the browser, it could be the web worker, where `window` object is not available. If I got it right, swc-loader is not configured correctly due to the problem.

See also: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Workers_API/Using_web_workers#web_workers_api
The first paragraph.

I'm using web worker and loaded worker code depends on other 3rd party library which checks window object.
It used to be working without any problems at Next.js version 14.0.4 or older. However it failed after upgrading next.js to 14.1.0. This error occurs both production and dev.
```
minimal.js:28 Uncaught ReferenceError: window is not defined
    at eval (webpack-internal:///(app-pages-browser)/./node_modules/protobufjs/src/util/minimal.js:28:68)
```

issue.title: Fix extra swc optimizer applied to node_modules in browser layer
issue.body:
### What

Disable swc transform optimizer for node_modules in browser layer of app router bundles

Fixes #61858
Fixes #60644 
Fixes #60920
Fixes #61740
Closes NEXT-2418

### Why

In browser there could be not only one runtime, it could have both js worker and browser. In js worker the `typeof window` is not as same as in browser, so disabling the swc optimizer which will replace the code. Leave the condition as it as.

body: We should disable the swc optimizer for the node_modules in app browser layer. I filled a [PR](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/62051) for fixing it
This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for 2 weeks. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.
